correctness.rationale: For the stopped interval (−b,a), checked the killed Green kernel via its zero boundary values, continuity at the origin and derivative jump −1/D. Its integral on the right reset-success region plus the right exit Laplace probability is sinh(kb)cosh(ka/2)/sinh(kL); reflection gives the left probability. Central resets give geometric retries with mean duration equal to mean trial duration divided by success probability. Writing u=ka/2 and v=kb/2, the resulting odds are p/(1−p)=sinh(v)/sinh(u) and the mean passage time has the stated hyperbolic form. Reflection alternates site types, so two consecutive adjacent-site passages give iid cycles of mean time 2τ and displacement {−L,0,L}, symmetric with second moment 2L²p(1−p). The variance rate remains valid even with displacement–duration correlation: if K is the first cycle whose finish exceeds t, the reward martingale stopped at K has zero mean and second moment E[K] times the one-cycle second moment. The event of including cycle i in that sum is decided before cycle i. The renewal law gives E[K]/t→1/(2τ), and the discrepancy between X_t and that stopped reward sum is uniformly bounded by 2L; it changes the variance by o(t). A fixed off-site start can be transferred at the first alarm, with square-integrable displacement and finite moments of the delay. This proves zero drift and the stated centered diffusivity. Rewriting the geometry-dependent factor as 2w+(cosh(s)−1)/w for w∈[1,c), c=cosh(kL/4), gives strict convexity and endpoint difference −2(c−1)(c²−c−1)/c. Hence the clustered endpoint is never attained, only equality of limiting and regular values occurs at c=φ, and all interior asymmetric spacings are then strictly suboptimal.
residual_risks: Positive gaps and fixed positive r,D,L only; the clustered endpoint is a limiting geometry, and the argument does not state a disordered-array variance law.
